title: CodeTask
description: A code task event delivered to the coding agent.

type.description: The category of work to perform.

branch.description: Branch to work on. For pr-review tasks, the PR head branch.

pr_number.description: Pull request number. Required for pr-review tasks.

description.description: Detailed description of what the agent should do.

context_files.description: File paths especially relevant to this task.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created.
